name: Lieke Vermeer
bio:
Lieke's fascination with motorsport began early, fueled by her grandfather's stories of working on classic racing engines. She pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in precision machining. Her practical skills quickly shone during internships, leading her to a position at ROWE Racing. 

Lieke is known for her meticulous approach and unwavering focus. She thrives on the challenge of crafting and maintaining high-performance components, always seeking ways to improve efficiency and reliability. Her dedication to precision and problem-solving makes her a valued member of the team.

What sets Lieke apart is her innate understanding of material properties and her ability to visualize complex designs. She often suggests minor adjustments that significantly improve performance, demonstrating a rare combination of technical expertise and intuitive insight.

physical.hairStyle: Long, straight hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Lieke is of average height with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always has a perfectly organized toolbox.
Whistles classical music while working on intricate parts.
Meticulously cleans her workspace after every task, regardless of size.
